Excellent service and treatment! I'm taking my two kittens for consultations and exams, and they are receiving excellent care from Dr. Amanda through the PET LOVE Plan. She's very calm, patient, and careful with them. I'm very grateful for this great service because I'm traumatized after taking my other kitten to the CAMEV Ipanema Clinic – he was already not eating properly and losing weight – and the doctor didn't admit him, saying she only admits after seeing the exams, and he was already very ill. The exams took a long time, and she only gave me a prescription 10 days later, for an opioid medication for humans, which he vomited (and she told me to give it to him again!). I didn't do that and took him urgently to my specialized veterinarian who admitted him immediately, put him on IV fluids and medication, and repeated the exams and abdominal ultrasound. This new ultrasound revealed the problem, which hadn't appeared in the CAMEV ultrasound report. He continued to receive excellent care, but due to the time lost at CAMEV, they couldn't save him and he passed away on Sunday the 20th. I should have taken my kitten to Dr. Amanda! Now I'm treating my other two kittens at Pet Zoyde with her and I highly recommend her! Very good, excellent!
